Correct; the dispatch's suggested spelling measured 137 bytes and was rightly shortened.
- `landing-operations.md:59` in place: 「落地前检三条」 → 「落地前检两条」. The count's single definition is `contract-review.md:32–36` (PR #23389's landed text): ① 达档条款②复核 PASS 在案, ② PR check 全绿 (roster skips being ②'s own exception); `lanes/director.md:35` points at 落地前检②; history (the dev deepened the clone to read it) shows `c2cce8fd1b` wrote 「三条」 when the list had three items and `7e0bfce400` retired the `--pair` item and renumbered without touching this line. The seat's own third reading — `check-governed-merges --pr` answering Tier S — is the tier classifier (`landing-operations.md:58`, the bullet above), not a condition. Correct: two.
- Under-tier route, read and not written: `execution-duties.md:112` (起隔离子代理) and `cross-repo-coordination.md:45` (未达档借隔离复核), both PR #23389's text, agree — the tier follows the face and a seat below it takes an isolated review at that tier. `SKILL.md:190` 「技能面 hunk 须由契约复审档的席复核,档外席先交 skills 席」 names a second route (hand the hunk to the skills seat); triage excluded `SKILL.md` from this card, so the drift is reported, not edited. The seat files the card (below).
